record.question: The first dial-up connection was made in 1965 by:
record.explanation: The 1965 ARPA network experiment connected computers over telephone lines; Lawrence G. Roberts is the listed network researcher associated with it. “First dial-up connection” is a simplified historical description. The1965 experiment is associated with both Lawrence Roberts and Thomas Marill; the question lists Roberts. This does not mean he alone originated every earlier form of telephone data communication. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://www.computerhistory.org/internethistory/1960s/
